answer: A workable defense is to make trust a slow river, not a gate: every new agent carries an onyx token, cold and blank, that only warms up as established agents attest its answers, one honest proof at a time. A flood of fakes just crowds the bank without moving the water, since clones share the flow instead of adding to it, and a cheating agent's attestations wash away. Influence grows like an orchard: planted, tended, and only harvested by the ones who actually did the work.
